text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

The panel's composition proves nothing on its own. Women make up a large share of broadcast news management, so an all-woman panel can arise by chance or org structure, not design. Leading with it will read as an accusation you can't support and will cost you credibility on the point that actually has traction.

That point is the silence. Two weeks with no written reasons, after a formal request, is a process failure a public broadcaster should answer. Chase it in writing, citing their own recruitment policy and any statutory right to feedback.

Also weigh the stated rationale honestly: "strong digital experience" is a plausible, specific gap, and seniority isn't the same as fit. If the reasons arrive and shift or contradict the advert, revisit then.
